title: Port command input schema validation, coercion and size budget
scope: The JSON-Schema subset validator and its exact error lines, the in-place true/false coercion, the names/id refusals, oneOf closest-branch reporting, and schemaWeight/SCHEMA_BUDGET, as a pure Rust function over an owned schema and value. Section 3.1a of SESSION-CONTRACT.md is the specification.
acceptance: Seeded schema and value generator (including oneOf, names, id/name, nested arrays, binary strings, non-finite numbers, undefined fields) compares original errors line by line, the returned coerced value and the weight figures against Rust, with a deliberately wrong error line rejected.
Every real command input schema from mcp/src/commands.json validates a corpus of accepted and refused inputs identically.
open_items: Value model must carry JS distinctions the schema checks (undefined versus null, Uint8Array versus array, non-finite numbers); decide the representation before coding.
Pure and dependency-free: no JSON crate needed beyond the repo's own value type.
